name: LeetCode New Problem
description: Pick and scaffold one new LeetCode practice problem (never solves it): a short auto-approved plan resolves the task, the scaffolder runs tools/new_problem.py --fetch and writes the statement, examples and edge-case questions into notes.md and one LC_CHECK per example into test.c, then an independent auditor checks no-solution/no-hint rules and correctness. Task: a topic (e.g. two-pointers) and/or a problem (e.g. 125 valid-palindrome).

nodes.label: Pick problem (plan)
nodes.goal: Plan only (no edits): resolve the task to ONE LeetCode problem per skill lc-new-problem section 1 (topic only -> first README starter for that topic not yet in c/ or cpp/). State id, title, slug, topic and the target directory c/<topic>/<id4>_<slug>/, and confirm it does not exist. Scope: only that new directory. Checks: list ONLY `gcc -std=c11 -fsyntax-only -I tools c/<topic>/<id4>_<slug>/test.c` and `git diff --check`. Never list tools/build_test.py: the empty stub reports TODO by design.

nodes.label: Auto-approve scaffold
nodes.purpose: Approved automatically: the scaffolder may create only the new c/<topic>/<id4>_<slug>/ directory

nodes.label: Scaffold problem
nodes.goal: Create the planned problem directory with `python tools/new_problem.py <topic> <id> <slug> --fetch`, then complete notes.md (Problem, Constraints, Examples, Edge cases to consider as input questions) and test.c (one LC_CHECK per official example, results freed) exactly as skill lc-new-problem says. solution.c keeps only the signature, an empty body and the TODO marker. Run the two planned checks. Change no other file.

nodes.label: Scaffold audit
criteria: only the new problem directory with solution.c, test.c, notes.md was created; nothing else changed
R1 solution.c is only the LeetCode signature, empty body and TODO marker; no solution logic in test.c
R2 Pattern empty, no Hints section, no technique named; edge cases are input questions only
R4 no learning-status change (progress.md, README, notes.md Status line)
statement, constraints, examples and signature match the LeetCode problem
each LC_CHECK matches its example, sizes match, results freed, no assumed order (verify by reading; inability to run commands is not a failure)

author.reason: Initial lc-new-problem flow (plan -> auto-approve -> scaffold -> repair -> audit, codex/gpt-6-luna); approved by user
